subtitle: AI 分诊、摘要与回复草稿的邮件概念应用
description: Agentic Mail 是一个五屏邮件应用:AI 分诊收件箱、阅读页 AI 摘要与建议行动、AI 起草回复(明确对象、可编辑、二次确认发送)、失败保留草稿可重试、跟进待办。真实收发走平台 mail 宿主服务(用户在宿主登录面板添加账号,凭据存系统密钥库,不经过应用);未提供该服务的环境(如 card-host)如实显示不可用并回退练习数据。AI 摘要与起草申请 model 权限,一次性调用设备配置的模型服务(schema 校验、每日预算;密钥不经过应用),不可用时回退本地模板并标注。(English: Agentic Mail is a five-screen mail app: AI-triaged inbox, reading view with an AI summary and suggested action, AI drafting with an explicit recipient and a two-step confirmed send, draft kept on failure with retry, and follow-up todos. Real mail goes through the platform's mail host service (accounts are added on the host's own sheet; credentials stay in the system vault, never in the app); where no service answers (card-host) the app says so and falls back to labelled practice data. AI summary and drafting request the model capability: one-shot schema-checked calls to the model service configured on the device, within a daily budget; where nothing answers, clearly labelled local templates are used.)
release_notes: 0.1.0:五屏应用。真实收发接入平台 mail 宿主服务(无服务环境回退练习数据并明示);回复生命周期跨屏同步;AI 摘要与起草接入 model 一次性模型服务,不可用回退本地模板。
